outcome: Postpartum rest and movement VAS scores
cohort: 160 parturients scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: The application of dexmedetomidine in the perioperative period of cesarean section was not only conducive to the early conversion of infant feeding to exclusive breastfeeding but could also improve the recovery quality and comfort of the parturient, optimize analgesia, shorten the time to first lactation, and increase lactation.
